basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old student currently living in Corvallis, Oregon, pursuing a degree in Environmental Science at Griffith University. I've always been a fan of the Pokémon franchise and recently started playing Pokémon Go to unwind from my studies. I'm a car enthusiast, particularly fond of my BMW 335i, and I enjoy exploring the beautiful Pacific Northwest. My typical online hours are in the evenings after classes and on weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending time with friends, both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise is primarily in environmental science, which I've been studying at Griffith University. I have a deep interest in sustainable practices and biodiversity. Additionally, I've self-taught myself about cars, particularly BMWs, through online forums and communities.
